recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16849 unless a future editorial pass separately revises ValueSet identification prose.
issue_request: FHIR-16849 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 ValueSet issue asking to improve the Value Set Identification sentence by changing "for legacy reasons and also to strongly encourage" to "for legacy reasons and to strongly encourage".
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied by git-svn commit 4461b3b1f8dee833b1f32f1f9d487981bb87c63d, "GF#16849 - grammar fix", which records svn revision 14731 and changes exactly that sentence in source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 6f7c3716ef8e176e5ea811ceb12844b81a3904ec updated nearby canonical URI/URL terminology in the same sentence while preserving the FHIR-16849 wording. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence record that conflicts with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/valueset/valueset-introduction.xml already says "for legacy reasons and to strongly encourage providing a resolvable URL as the identifier whenever possible".
